description: Layer 1 trigger pack for designing one feature or workflow before implementation: compare approaches, narrow scope, ask one focused question at a time when needed, and produce a concrete design spec.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Design our team invite approval workflow before we code it. Compare a couple of directions and turn the winner into a spec.
shouldTrigger.reason: Feature design request for an existing product with explicit approach comparison and spec output.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Help me brainstorm how subscription pause should work inside our product. Ask one focused question at a time and recommend the best direction.
shouldTrigger.reason: Collaborative design of one existing feature before implementation.

shouldTrigger.prompt: I need a feature design for admin approval of payouts: goals, non-goals, approaches, and the chosen flow.
shouldTrigger.reason: Explicit request to design one workflow and document the decision.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Turn this rough idea for delegated workspace access into a concrete design doc before anyone starts implementing it.
shouldTrigger.reason: Requests a design-stage artifact for an existing product feature.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Compare 2-3 ways to build subscription recovery in our app and tell me which design we should commit to.
shouldTrigger.reason: Approach comparison and recommendation for one feature design decision.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Let's design the reporting-permissions workflow step by step before we write code.
shouldTrigger.reason: Interactive feature-design request inside an existing product.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Run /feature-design for enterprise invite approvals. Keep it interactive until you have enough to write the spec.
shouldTrigger.reason: Explicit invocation of the feature-design skill.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Before implementation, design the account-freeze flow for fraud reviews and give me the recommended direction plus open questions.
shouldTrigger.reason: Design request for one operational feature before coding.

shouldTrigger.prompt: I do not want a broad audit. I want help deciding how the new cancellation flow should work and what the approved spec should say.
shouldTrigger.reason: Explicitly rules out feature-audit and asks for design direction plus spec output.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Help me narrow this feature idea into a shippable design with scope, non-goals, edge cases, and rollout notes.
shouldTrigger.reason: Matches the design-stage workflow for one feature in an existing product.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Audit our upgrade funnel end to end: competitor patterns, product gaps, UX friction, and a roadmap for what to build next.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /feature-audit: broad analysis of an existing feature across many lanes.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Be brutally honest about this startup idea, and if it survives scaffold the project plan and CLAUDE.md for me.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /idea-audit: new project idea evaluation plus scaffolding.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Pressure-test this rollout plan for default transcript uploads. I want the real holes before we ship, not a polite summary.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /pressure-test: adversarial analysis of one proposal.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Give me a v0.dev prompt for redesigning the analytics dashboard.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /v0-design: UI prompt generation rather than product behavior design.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Review this diff for runtime bugs, security issues, and broken logic. Keep false positives low.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /quick-review: code review of a diff or PR.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Find the real bug in this flaky payment flow, prove the root cause, fix it, and add a regression test.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /deep-fix: debugging plus implementation and proof.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Generate unit tests for src/orders.js and follow the repo's Vitest style.
Analyze this branch diff and give me a deploy checklist: env vars, migrations, new workers, and breaking changes.
Scout the best external skills for this repo and explain which ones we should import first.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /skill-scout: external skill discovery, not feature design.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Turn this imported skill into Arcana quality: rewrite the frontmatter, structure, and missing sections.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /import-skill: skill adaptation workflow, not feature design.
